name: Tolox (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of green, white and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Tolox (a mountain and a chestnut tree on blue and white).
history: Municipal flag of Tolox; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Tolox arms — mountain and chestnut tree on blue and white
